help.title: How it works
help.step1: When you publish a post with external links, it's added to the pending queue
help.step2: The background process runs every 5 minutes to send webmentions
help.step3: For each link, we discover the webmention endpoint and send a notification
help.step4: Once processed, the post is marked as sent
